SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM donation WHERE YEAR(donated_at) = YEAR(NOW()) AND MONTH(donated_at) = MONTH(NOW())
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign WHERE status IN ('모집완료', '사용완료')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE member_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE member_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE member_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND org_status = 'PENDING'

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(donated_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM donation WHERE donated_at >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 5 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(category, ''), '기타') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM campaign GROUP BY label ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(region, ''), '기타') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM campaign GROUP BY label ORDER BY count DESC
